EVD-ADVERSE-MEDIA.name: Adverse media screening result
EVD-ADVERSE-MEDIA.description: Adverse media screening across the institution's lookback window.

EVD-BENEFICIAL-OWNERSHIP.name: Beneficial ownership certification
EVD-BENEFICIAL-OWNERSHIP.description: Certification of beneficial owners at 25% or more plus one control person.

EVD-BUSINESS-REGISTRATION.name: Business registration evidence
EVD-BUSINESS-REGISTRATION.description: Registration or formation evidence for the sole proprietorship or entity.

EVD-CIP-ADDRESS.name: Address evidence
EVD-CIP-ADDRESS.description: Evidence of the customer's residential or principal business street address.

EVD-CIP-IDENTITY-DOCUMENT.name: Government identity document
EVD-CIP-IDENTITY-DOCUMENT.description: A government-issued identity document evidencing legal name and date of birth.

EVD-CIP-TIN.name: Taxpayer identification evidence
EVD-CIP-TIN.description: Evidence of the taxpayer identification number asserted at intake.

EVD-DECISION-RECOMMENDATION.name: Decision recommendation record
EVD-DECISION-RECOMMENDATION.description: The agent's recommendation with its policy, finding and evidence citations.

EVD-EDD-NARRATIVE.name: Enhanced due diligence narrative
EVD-EDD-NARRATIVE.description: The documented EDD rationale for an elevated or high-risk relationship.

EVD-IDENTITY-VERIFICATION.name: Identity verification result
EVD-IDENTITY-VERIFICATION.description: The documentary or non-documentary verification result for the subject.

EVD-PEP-SCREENING.name: PEP screening result
EVD-PEP-SCREENING.description: A politically exposed person screening result with tier and relationship basis.

EVD-POLICY-AUTHORITY.name: Pinned policy authority snapshot
EVD-POLICY-AUTHORITY.description: The authoritative policy snapshot the case is pinned to.

EVD-PUBLIC-SOURCE-RESEARCH.name: Public-source investigation record
EVD-PUBLIC-SOURCE-RESEARCH.description: The bounded public-source investigation record, with per-assertion source URL, publisher, retrieval time and provider.

EVD-QA-REVIEW.name: Quality assurance review record
EVD-QA-REVIEW.description: The QA reviewer's assessment of a sampled disposition.

EVD-RELATIONSHIP-PURPOSE.name: Purpose and expected activity
EVD-RELATIONSHIP-PURPOSE.description: Recorded purpose of the relationship and expected activity profile.

EVD-SANCTIONS-SCREENING.name: Sanctions screening result
EVD-SANCTIONS-SCREENING.description: A sanctions screening result recording provider, list version, list publication date and every alert produced.

EVD-SOURCE-OF-FUNDS.name: Source of funds evidence
EVD-SOURCE-OF-FUNDS.description: Evidence of the origin of the funds involved in the relationship.

RC-LOW-STANDARD-INDIVIDUAL.name: Low-risk standard individual
RC-LOW-STANDARD-INDIVIDUAL.description: The only cohort in which a deterministic gate may approve without a human, and then only while a current signed attestation covers it.

ADVERSE_MEDIA_REVIEW_REQUIRED.summary: Adverse media within the policy lookback window requires analyst assessment.
ADVERSE_MEDIA_REVIEW_REQUIRED.analystGuidance: Assess relevance, recency and subject attribution of the adverse media.

APPROVAL_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET.summary: An approval was recommended but at least one approval requirement is unmet.
APPROVAL_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET.analystGuidance: The unmet requirement IDs are in the evaluation detail; resolve or decide manually.

AUTOMATIC_APPROVAL_ATTESTATION_MISSING.summary: The automatic-approval cohort attestation is absent, expired or unverified.
AUTOMATIC_APPROVAL_ATTESTATION_MISSING.analystGuidance: Automatic approval requires a current, signed cohort attestation. Without it every case in the cohort is routed to a human.

BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_INCOMPLETE.summary: Beneficial ownership information required for this cohort is missing.
BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_INCOMPLETE.analystGuidance: Collect and verify beneficial ownership for the legal entity before the case can reach decision readiness.

CASE_SNAPSHOT_STALE.summary: The evaluated case snapshot was superseded before the decision was applied.
CASE_SNAPSHOT_STALE.analystGuidance: The case changed between snapshot read and policy application. Re-evaluate against the current sequence; never apply a decision computed from a superseded snapshot.

CIP_CORE_ATTRIBUTES_INCOMPLETE.summary: Required customer identification attributes are absent from the case.
CIP_CORE_ATTRIBUTES_INCOMPLETE.analystGuidance: Name, date of birth, residential address and taxpayer identification number are required before screening. Request the missing attributes from intake.

COHORT_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_AUTOMATIC_APPROV.summary: The case cohort is outside the attested automatic-approval scope.
COHORT_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_AUTOMATIC_APPROV.analystGuidance: Automatic approval is limited to attested low-risk cohorts. This case requires a human approval decision.

CONFIDENCE_BELOW_THRESHOLD.summary: Recommendation confidence is below the configured automatic-disposition threshold.
CONFIDENCE_BELOW_THRESHOLD.analystGuidance: Treat the recommendation as advisory only and decide on the evidence.

CONFIRMED_SANCTIONS_MATCH.summary: Screening produced a confirmed sanctions match.
CONFIRMED_SANCTIONS_MATCH.analystGuidance: Escalate immediately under the sanctions procedure. The platform does not decline automatically; a human with sanctions authority owns the disposition and any blocking or reporting obligation.

DECISION_PRECONDITIONS_SATISFIED.summary: Policy, investigation and evidence obligations are sufficient for a recommendation.
DECISION_PRECONDITIONS_SATISFIED.analystGuidance: No action; the case may proceed to decision.

DECLINE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_AUTHORITY.summary: A decline recommendation was made; declines are never automatic.
DECLINE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_AUTHORITY.analystGuidance: Adjudicate the recommended decline. Only a human with decline authority, under dual control, may finalize a DECLINED disposition.

DUAL_CONTROL_REQUIRED.summary: The disposition requires a second approver under dual control.
DUAL_CONTROL_REQUIRED.analystGuidance: Route to a second approver with the required role; the first approver may not self-confirm.

EDD_OBLIGATIONS_INCOMPLETE.summary: Enhanced due diligence obligations for an elevated or high-risk cohort are unmet.
EDD_OBLIGATIONS_INCOMPLETE.analystGuidance: Complete source-of-funds, relationship-purpose and EDD narrative obligations before the case may reach decision readiness.

EVIDENCE_EXPIRED.summary: Evidence satisfying an obligation is outside its freshness window.
EVIDENCE_EXPIRED.analystGuidance: Refresh the expired evidence before approval.

HIGH_RISK_JURISDICTION_REVIEW.summary: The subject jurisdiction is on the institution's high-risk list.
HIGH_RISK_JURISDICTION_REVIEW.analystGuidance: Complete the jurisdiction-specific EDD obligations and record the rationale.

HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.summary: The recommendation explicitly requires human review.
HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.analystGuidance: Review the cited rationale, evidence and findings, then decide.

IDENTITY_CONFLICT.summary: Investigation surfaced an unresolved identity conflict for the subject.
IDENTITY_CONFLICT.analystGuidance: Resolve the identity conflict before any approval; re-verify identity evidence.

INVESTIGATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING.summary: No public-source investigation evidence is linked to the case.
INVESTIGATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING.analystGuidance: Re-run investigation; a completed work item without evidence is not a result.

INVESTIGATION_INCOMPLETE.summary: The public-source investigation work item is not completed.
INVESTIGATION_INCOMPLETE.analystGuidance: Await or re-dispatch the investigation work item.

KYC_REQUIREMENTS_SATISFIED.summary: Every approval requirement is satisfied for an attested automatic-approval cohort.
KYC_REQUIREMENTS_SATISFIED.analystGuidance: No action; the case is approved under the attested low-risk cohort scope.

MATERIAL_CONTRADICTION.summary: An open high-materiality contradiction exists on the case.
MATERIAL_CONTRADICTION.analystGuidance: Resolve or accept the contradiction with rationale before disposition.

NO_AUTOMATIC_DISPOSITION_RULE.summary: No disposition rule matched; the policy defaults to human review.
NO_AUTOMATIC_DISPOSITION_RULE.analystGuidance: Nothing falls through to approval. Decide manually and report the uncovered combination to the policy owner so a rule can be authored.

PEP_REVIEW_REQUIRED.summary: A politically exposed person signal requires the policy-defined review path.
PEP_REVIEW_REQUIRED.analystGuidance: Confirm PEP tier and complete the EDD obligations for PEP relationships.

POLICY_AUTHORITY_MISSING.summary: The case carries no authoritative policy evidence.
POLICY_AUTHORITY_MISSING.analystGuidance: The policy context agent did not link KYC_POLICY_AUTHORITY evidence. Re-run policy resolution; do not proceed on an unpinned policy.

POLICY_CLAIM_MISSING.summary: No applicable_kyc_policy claim exists on the case.
POLICY_CLAIM_MISSING.analystGuidance: Re-run the policy context agent; screening cannot begin unpinned.

POLICY_CONTEXT_MISSING.summary: The case carries no resolved policy context at decision readiness.
POLICY_CONTEXT_MISSING.analystGuidance: The applicable_kyc_policy claim is absent when it should already exist. Restart the case at policy resolution rather than deciding without context.

POLICY_EVALUATION_ERROR.summary: The policy engine failed to produce a decision.
POLICY_EVALUATION_ERROR.analystGuidance: Treat as no decision. The case stays where it is and goes to a human; an errored evaluation never advances a case.

POLICY_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH.summary: The policy claim digest does not match the case policy authority digest.
POLICY_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH.analystGuidance: Evidence was produced against a different policy snapshot than the case is pinned to. Treat all downstream findings as suspect and restart the case at intake.

POLICY_SNAPSHOT_STALE.summary: The pinned policy snapshot is older than the configured freshness window.
POLICY_SNAPSHOT_STALE.analystGuidance: Re-pin the case to the current policy version and re-screen.

POLICY_UNKNOWN_INPUT.summary: A required policy input could not be determined from the case snapshot.
POLICY_UNKNOWN_INPUT.analystGuidance: Missing information fails closed. The undetermined condition IDs are in the evaluation detail.

POSSIBLE_SANCTIONS_MATCH.summary: Screening produced a possible sanctions match requiring adjudication.
POSSIBLE_SANCTIONS_MATCH.analystGuidance: Adjudicate the alert against the list record. Clearing a sanctions alert requires dual control; it is never automatic.

PRODUCTION_POLICY_CONFIGURATION_UNRESOLV.summary: The pinned bundle's institution settings are unresolved or unapproved.
PRODUCTION_POLICY_CONFIGURATION_UNRESOLV.analystGuidance: The bundle is a candidate, not an approved policy. No disposition may be reached against it. Resolve the outstanding owner inputs and promote an approved bundle; until then every case in flight is a human's to decide outside this gate.

RECOMMENDATION_CITATIONS_INCOMPLETE.summary: The recommendation omits required policy, finding or evidence citations.
RECOMMENDATION_CITATIONS_INCOMPLETE.analystGuidance: An uncited recommendation is not reviewable. Decide from the case record and report the agent defect.

RECOMMENDATION_MISSING.summary: No decision recommendation exists on the case.
RECOMMENDATION_MISSING.analystGuidance: The decision agent produced no recommendation; re-dispatch or review manually.

REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING.summary: One or more policy evidence obligations are unsatisfied.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING.analystGuidance: The unsatisfied obligation IDs are listed in the evaluation detail. Obtain the evidence or route the case for an EDD exception decision.

SANCTIONS_LIST_STALE.summary: The sanctions list version used for screening is older than the permitted window.
SANCTIONS_LIST_STALE.analystGuidance: Re-screen against the current list version before any disposition.

SCREENING_PRECONDITIONS_SATISFIED.summary: Authoritative policy context is pinned and intake attributes are complete.
SCREENING_PRECONDITIONS_SATISFIED.analystGuidance: No action; the case may proceed to screening.

SCREENING_PROVIDER_OUTAGE.summary: A required screening provider was unavailable or returned a degraded result.
SCREENING_PROVIDER_OUTAGE.analystGuidance: Screening coverage is incomplete. Do not approve on partial coverage; re-screen once the provider recovers, or complete a manual screen and record it as evidence.
